evals.prompt: 把 /absolute/path/invoice.png 里的文字识别出来，这是一张普通发票截图。
evals.expected_output: Uses the default rapidocr engine through the ai-services client (or the connected MCP ocr_document tool), reports the extracted text, and flags low confidence or warnings instead of silently correcting amounts, dates or identifiers.

evals.prompt: 这份 /absolute/path/financials.pdf 前 3 页有很多合并单元格的表格，帮我提取成可以直接贴进文档的格式。
evals.expected_output: Chooses --engine qwen because the pages are tables with merged cells, passes --pages 1-3, and returns Markdown (or HTML tables) rather than flattened plain text.

evals.prompt: 把 /absolute/path/meeting.m4a 转成文字，会议是中文的，我要带时间戳的版本。
evals.expected_output: Uses the asr command with --language zh and --format json to include timestamped segments, authenticates through company Cloudflare Access, and does not expose credentials.

evals.prompt: 给我生成一段 4000 字的 MP3 旁白，用 Serena。
evals.expected_output: Explains that each TTS request is limited to 3000 characters and the output is MP3 only, proposes splitting at sentence boundaries, and only proceeds with the user's agreement; it does not send the 4000-character text in one request.

evals.prompt: 怎么让我的 Codex 接上 ai-services 这个 MCP？
evals.expected_output: Gives the https://ai-services.preseen.ai/mcp endpoint and the Codex config.toml snippet, states that authentication is Cloudflare Access OAuth, and tells the user never to put credentials in the URL.
